independence.currentRefutationAssessment: No current source defect finding survives these refutation passes. This does not establish visual, complete scene-budget or browser/GPU performance satisfaction.

addressedCandidates.originalObservation: The installed r180 renderer submits and counts one zero-count colour draw for each populated batch. The initial source comment incorrectly claimed no colour draw.
addressedCandidates.currentDisposition: Addressed as a contract/claim issue: comments now acknowledge counted overhead and the test claims zero colour triangles. Two populated proxies still add two zero-count colour draws; full submission budgets must include those calls.

addressedCandidates.originalObservation: The intermediate unsimplified one-Ren roof source fixture submitted 325,026 colour+shadow triangles, above the 300,000 budget. A separate City-only source probe confirmed 322,482 at authored y=11.4 and 322,698 at near-roof y=10.1, so the excess did not depend on the extra actor fixture.
addressedCandidates.currentDisposition: Addressed within the bounded source fixture by the planar shadow-index path. The same one-Ren fixture now submits 275,254 triangles, including 155,008 unchanged colour triangles. The independent City-only probe gives 272,710 / 272,926 at the two heights. These exclude atmosphere/post effects and do not establish full-game budget satisfaction.

addressedCandidates.originalObservation: One warm ShadowBatches.update allocates 60 new typed arrays totaling 210,612 bytes for the actual performance-fixture loadout. Every dynamic position/index array is replaced although all source topologies are unchanged. This is 12,636,720 bytes/second at 60 updates/second, an arithmetic rate rather than a measured game frame rate.
addressedCandidates.currentDisposition: Addressed by retained pack storage, revision counters and destination batch-version checks. Separate constructor interception on both the actual Player + seven Enemy loadout and the eight-Actor fixture reports 0 typed-array allocations and 0 bytes in a warm update; pack arrays are reused, animated source and destination positions change, and destination BufferAttribute.version advances. The full source probe reports 0 newly allocated dynamic typed-array bytes/update across 120 warm updates.
addressedCandidates.refutation: Confirmed by a separate agent; no current finding survives.

verifiedSourceObservations.explanation: For every actual City builder, each original tagged-grid triangle vertex is inside the coarse face union within 0.0001 world units; face orientation and area agree. Every colour position, normal, UV, colour and index buffer is byte-identical to HEAD MeshBuilder.build applied to the same current builder data. This isolates the metadata change from the independently changing roof-scatter code.
verifiedSourceObservations.independentRefutation: The separate refuter verified closed oriented boundaries, coplanarity, unchanged uncovered spans, all 63 nonempty box-face masks, both plane sides, tilt/rotation, mixed primitives, and translated/nested appends.

verifiedSourceObservations.area: current poses, hidden/removal state and morphs
verifiedSourceObservations.result: Current pooled+planar code passes the eight-city-position and five-real-animation-clip probes (atk1, heavy, dodge, death, throw, three phases each). Selected sources remain present and shader-equivalent posed vertices match within 0.000014 world units. Hidden and removed actor checks, re-addition and morph refresh pass. The independent allocation probe separately confirms that destination batch vertices and upload versions change under pooling.

verifiedSourceObservations.area: renderer lifecycle, side rules and pass hooks
verifiedSourceObservations.result: Installed WebGLShadowMap executes onBeforeShadow before renderBufferDirect reads drawRange. Original depth side selection and negative-object-transform front-face behavior match the batch winding path for the current PCFSoftShadowMap configuration. Actual WebGLGeometries/WebGLObjects source with tracked allocations releases growth/disposal buffers; geometry memory and tracked attributes return to zero after disposal. Ray picking ignores proxies.

nonFindingObservations.observation: A later external castShadow=false write on an owned source is ignored and release paths restore true. A separate refuter reproduced this API limitation, but no current product caller disables a mesh after it becomes owned; current callers use construction-time flags and visibility/removal. Not promoted to a present gameplay defect.

scopeLimits: No browser/server or real WebGL context was launched, and no pixels, shader compilation, GPU timing, screenshots or smartphone frame pacing were measured.
City source geometry and real rig/animation classes were used; opaque shadow-equivalent material substitutes and an inert sign canvas avoided a browser. Runtime material appearance is not judged.

Full-scene atmosphere, post-processing and other gameplay effects are absent from the source submission fixture. Normal/worst draw, triangle, JS-time and memory budgets require the authorized complete-scene CI run.
Review covers the current directional PCFSoftShadowMap path. Other shadow-map types, point-light/custom-distance paths, arbitrary caller mutations and unsupported material features are not approved.
No blind/reference comparison occurred. All element satisfaction and overall product quality remain unmeasured by this review.
verdictScope: Only the explicit source checks and reproduced Node renderer-method probes. No current source defect survived the separate refutation. This is not a product, element, pixel, browser, performance or release approval.

currentSourceMeasurements.timingLimit: Node preparation timings exclude shader/GPU work and the full game frame. They do not establish the 8 ms browser frame budget.
